program='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg)
    for color in colors:
        pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if len(pts) < 3:
            continue
        # Continue a diagonal run from its terminal pair, in the same direction.
        for r, c in pts:
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1), (-1, 1), (-1, -1)):
                prev = (r-dr, c-dc)
                if not (0 <= prev[0] < h and 0 <= prev[1] < w and grid[prev[0]][prev[1]] == color):
                    continue
                nxt = (r+dr, c+dc)
                while 0 <= nxt[0] < h and 0 <= nxt[1] < w and grid[nxt[0]][nxt[1]] == bg:
                    out[nxt[0]][nxt[1]] = color
                    nxt = (nxt[0]+dr, nxt[1]+dc)
    return out
'''
